connector.name: Youtube MCP by miller-joe
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for YouTube creator-ops with a ComfyUI bridge for AI thumbnail generation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package youtube-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the miller-joe account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID (from Google Cloud Console, Desktop app type). See README for setup.

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client Secret. Pair with YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID.

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE
env.description: Alternative to CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET: path to the JSON credentials file downloaded from Google Cloud.

env.name: COMFYUI_URL
env.description: ComfyUI HTTP URL for the generate_and_set_thumbnail bridge tool. When unset, that tool is disabled.

env.name: COMFYUI_DEFAULT_CKPT
env.description: Default ComfyUI checkpoint filename for bridge tool (default: sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors)
